ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:

Reasoning: Use vectors to represent the centroids of the four triangles. Let G1=(A+B+P)/3 be the centroid of △ABP, G2=(B+C+P)/3 be the centroid of △BCP, G3=(C+D+P)/3 be the centroid of △CDP, G4=(D+A+P)/3 be the centroid of △DAP. The difference of adjacent centroids is G2-G1=(C-A)/3, G3-G2=(D-B)/3. Similarly, G4-G3=(A-C)/3, G1-G4=(B-D)/3, so the sides of this quadrilateral are respectively parallel to the two diagonals of the square. The side length of the square is 30, therefore the lengths of diagonals AC and BD are both 30√2, and they are perpendicular to each other. Therefore the adjacent side lengths of the centroid quadrilateral are (30√2)/3=10√2, and they are perpendicular to each other, so it is a square. The area is (10√2)^2=200. AP=12 and BP=26 are only used to explain the position of P, and do not affect the area.

method.method_draft: Use vectors for the four centroid positions. From the image/text, take the square vertices in cyclic order as A, B, C, D and let the four centroids be G1=(A+B+P)/3, G2=(B+C+P)/3, G3=(C+D+P)/3, G4=(D+A+P)/3. Compute adjacent side vectors: G2-G1=(C-A)/3 and G3-G2=(D-B)/3. In a square of side 30, diagonals AC and BD have length 30√2 and are perpendicular, so these adjacent vectors have length 10√2 and are perpendicular. Therefore the centroid quadrilateral is a square with area (10√2)^2=200. The given AP and BP distances are not needed except to locate P inside and ensure the named triangles are well-defined.

method.method_draft: Relate each centroid to a side midpoint. Let M_AB, M_BC, M_CD, M_DA be the midpoints of the four sides of the square. The centroid of triangle ABP is (A+B+P)/3 = (2/3)M_AB + (1/3)P, and similarly for the other three sides. Thus the centroid quadrilateral is the image of the midpoint quadrilateral M_AB M_BC M_CD M_DA under a homothety centered at P with scale factor 2/3. The midpoint quadrilateral of a square is a square whose diagonals are the side lengths of the original square, so its area is half the area of ABCD: 30^2/2=450. Scaling lengths by 2/3 scales area by 4/9, giving 450·4/9=200.
method.CoT_raw:
先看图像：这是一个边长为30的正方形ABCD，点P在内部，四个三角形ABP、BCP、CDP、DAP的重心连成一个凸四边形。

设AB、BC、CD、DA的中点分别为M_AB、M_BC、M_CD、M_DA。以向量或坐标表示，三角形ABP的重心是(A+B+P)/3。由于M_AB=(A+B)/2，所以
(A+B+P)/3 = (2/3)M_AB + (1/3)P,
这正是以P为中心、比例因子2/3的伸缩把M_AB映到该重心的结果。其余三个三角形同理，四个重心分别是中点四边形在以P为中心、比例2/3的相似变换下的像。

因此，重心四边形的面积 = 中点四边形面积 × (2/3)^2。

再看正方形ABCD的中点四边形：它是一个正方形，其两条对角线分别等于原正方形的边长30和30，所以面积为 30×30/2 = 450。

于是所求面积为 450×4/9 = 200。

因此答案是200。
